{color:#ff991f}*Reproduce Steps:*{color}

# Deducted volume invoice ( Debit/Credit ) 
# run correction flow for this volume invoice 
# check connection between , Volume , interim , correction debit and correction credit invoices.

{color:#36b37e}Actual Result:{color}

missing connection , when user run correction flow for deducted volume invoice.

{color:#ff5630}*Expected Result:*{color}

In interim invoice should be added both correction invoices.
In Deducted volume should be added both correction invoices.
In correction credit and debit invoices , should be added interim invoice and Deducted volume invoice.
